title: Ukrainian Turbo Minesweeper — Gameplay Showcase (Free Browser Game)
author: Elegant-Mention6393
selftext:
Using Claude Code and my own experience in game design, we built a vastly upgraded custom version of Minesweeper that has weather, day-night cycle, randomized 10-level campaigns, epic explosive cutscenes and more.

It took me a few weeks to build this and it is fairly bit more complicated given the various additional systems that went into it.

The cool thing with this project is that I made available the debug devtools that I used myself to fine tune the various components in the game. If you download the offline version of it, you can get those same devtools and implement similar weather and zone themes to your 2D games too.

comments.author: Elegant-Mention6393
